verdict.early_visual_gate: DEFER unchanged retention; one narrow appearance refinement is coherent to test.
verdict.net_gain: Consistent small positive whole-character tonal change across all three eras and both held lights: the pale front crown is cooler and fits surrounding steel a little better. This is a local tonal improvement, not a meaningful head identity reconstruction.
verdict.cost: Gray polygon patches are conspicuous in the head read and remain present in both lights. They weaken coherent metal/plate response and do not follow the source swept overlapping crown. Whole-scale cost is modest; head-scale source departure is clear.
verdict.gain_without_meaningful_cost: Not established strongly enough to retain this exact trial unchanged. The main source mismatch remains a broad smooth helmet-like roof, now with a facet mosaic. No new optic/stance loss is apparent in these six canon pairs.
verdict.scope: Early visual direction only. No final model acceptance, source likeness pass, owner acceptance, material custody, renderer parity or browser claim.

specific_evidence.finding: Advanced/Builder crown center above the orange optic changes from broad pale warm surface to cool gray; bronze edge remains thin, orange core stays readable. In the changed surface there are disconnected large gray facets rather than source plate overlap/fastener structure.
Maker and Mechanic show the same local gray-facet treatment in both lights; both visible optics stay dark. Little differentiated era finish is evident from this local change.

Canon/July head/First Choice source crown uses fitted swept segmentation, narrow bronze brow and dense orbital/cheek enclosure. Candidate still has a wide plain cap, thick round eye surround, dark front slot/cavity beneath the roof and exposed ribbon-like cheek line; these dominate identity more than the tonal shift.

Sources retain dense layered metal and finer mechanical continuity. Candidate body remains comparatively soft, regularly feathered, and sparse in leg/torso hardware; local cap appearance cannot close those gaps.
All21 resource hashes and byte lengths exactly match pinned image-only manifest; originals unmodified.

specific_evidence.tier: unknown until authorized phase2 / broader views
specific_evidence.finding: Cause of polygon patches, actual material graph/map/normal binding, payload preservation, true camera/light equality, opposite profile/rear continuity and export/browser appearance were not inspected.

smallest_coherent_next_visual_test.proposal: One versioned material-only cap refinement comparing this trial with a continuous source-compatible dark steel response that suppresses the disconnected polygon patch pattern while retaining the narrow bronze edge and existing geometry. Do not cover or recolor optics or change the held lights to make it look better.
smallest_coherent_next_visual_test.first_packet: Matched Builder whole neutral and workshop before/current/refinement, plus the same head ROI to see whether the facet cost has gone. If that passes, repeat whole pairs for Maker and Mechanic and supply opposite profile/rear before retention.
smallest_coherent_next_visual_test.pass_condition: At whole scale under both held lights the broad crown integrates with surrounding metal, but plate borders/optic/bill remain readable; at head scale it loses the gray mosaic rather than becoming a featureless black patch. Claim only tonal continuity progress if geometry gaps stay unchanged.
smallest_coherent_next_visual_test.failure_condition: No useful whole gain, persistent arbitrary facets, collapsed edge/optic readability or a dramatic-light-only result. Stop the appearance direction rather than treating source-missing geometry as a texture success.
